image_description: A person standing outdoors on a low brick wall next to a hedge, wearing a black academic gown with blue velvet panels and a mortarboard cap. The subject is pointing upwards with their right hand towards a banner on a pole that reads 'IT'S THE BRIGHTEST MINDS THAT WILL MAKE TOMORROW BETTER.' The background consists of green trees and a brick building.

The gown opens at the front, revealing the blue lining/panels, and maintains general bilateral symmetry in its cut, although the pose creates some asymmetry in the drape.
The fabric hangs loosely, effectively hiding the specific shape of the torso and legs beneath it.

While likely worn over clothes, the specific nature of the underlying attire (formal vs casual) is largely obscured by the gown and cannot be definitively verified visually.
